text: There are two concerns in tension: removing the compatibility aliases and respecting the unresolved status of two clients. 1) The migration renamed three public fields while retaining compatibility aliases. 2) Twelve of fourteen known clients have migrated, but the other two clients’ status is unknown. 3) Integration tests cover the twelve migrated clients, not the two of unknown status—a small count, but a real blind spot. I acknowledge the strong migration progress; my narrower concern is where the evidence ends. I therefore recommend rejecting removal for now: known is covered, unknown is blocking. Do not remove the aliases until both remaining client owners confirm migration.
